svg.text: Every route of the Angular app (21), what the page shows and where it leads, grouped as the navbar groups them.
First Tab: "Skip to main content". On a phone the links fold under Menu. Footer on every page: crest → /, privacy policy.
Community: Party Finder, Venues, Events, The Waking Sands · Tools: Duty Roulette, Market History
• Tabs, each at its own address: Weekly (/), Hunts (?view=hunts), Your Feed
• Weekly: the next resets, this week's Fashion Report and Island Sanctuary
picks; Hunts: the hunt trains per data centre, asked every minute (both
• Feeds: posts with favourites and a pager, a tag filter; new posts arrive

• Optionally shared in the Everise Discord

• Data centre, world, category, role, words, sort and page in the address
• Asked again every 30 seconds while in view
• Members: Share as post, or Share to Discord with a picture of the card

• An item's median sale price per world over time, the cheapest listings now

• Then "Check your email" for the confirmation link

• Emails a code, then a new password, typed twice
• Every device is signed out afterwards

• A Waking Sands character: /profile/character:<id>, no follow

• What the site keeps and why; linked from the footer

text.tspan: ; signed-out visitors of a guarded page go to
Links shared in the Discord carry
: whoever opens one signed out signs in first (discordLinkGuard), then comes back.
· form errors in the backend’s words, on the form.
Session: an httpOnly cookie from the backend, sent with every call to the same-origin
. Members get the notifications bell in the header.
Search engines: the Worker writes each public page’s title, description and words; event and venue pages are noindex, staging is never indexed.
Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): every page has its own title and one
; a page change moves the focus to it; dialogs keep the focus inside.
Pages are lazy-loaded per route; a deep link is served the app shell by Cloudflare (SPA fallback).
